name: helan-lingyou-ningxia
description: Six-agent expert team for Ningxia culture, Helan Mountain ecology and evidence-grounded smart travel planning, with a self-contained deterministic engine (zero third-party dependencies) shipped inside the package for cross-machine reproducibility.

displayDescription.en: Six specialists covering Ningxia culture, Helan Mountain ecology Q&A and personalized itinerary planning, with multi-turn revision, traceable evidence and verifiable results.
